room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on other expenses if higher room taken, except pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern/advanced procedures (robotic surgery, etc.): up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Accidents exempt; waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: No reduction option mentioned; portability credits apply

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (hernia, cataract, etc.); 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; time limit of 24 hrs does not apply for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure A are not payable; no consumables cover rider available

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with transfer of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, overseas treatment, infertility/IVF, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
